It must avoid obstacles and minimize travel distance. Formulate the search problem. Define all components of problem formulation. Explain which search algorithm would be most suitable.

question_text: Consider the graph shown below where the numbers on the links are link costs and the numbers next to the states are heuristic estimates. Note that the arcs are undirected. Edges: A-B 1, A-C 3, B-C 1, B-G 9, C-G 5, C-H 2, G-H 1.] Perform Greedy Best First Search and A* search with a strict expanded list on this graph.
